startScreen.title: How You Dare
description: Do not post, touch, message, or involve anyone without permission.

endScreen.title: You Survived
endScreen.subtitle: You looked ridiculous on purpose. That is a respectable skill.

questions.question: Perform a 30-second dance as a piece of fried chicken discovering free will.
Hold an impossibly serious fashion pose until your next turn.
Maintain eye contact with the person on your left while attempting one harmless impossible task.
Do five slow-motion victory celebrations. The group names the sport after each one.
Deliver breaking news about an ordinary object in this room.
Draft a suspicious text about a sandwich. Read it aloud, but do not send it.
Speak in an operatic voice for the next two rounds.
Let the group choose one photo from your camera roll that you are comfortable showing only in this room.
Give everyone an absurd award based on what they have done during this game.
Tell the person on your right which fruit matches their energy, then defend your answer like a lawyer.
Whisper the title of your most embarrassing comfort movie as if it were classified information.
Lose a staring contest with an object, then give it a sincere apology.
Trade one removable accessory with a willing player until the next round.
Make the group laugh without touching anyone or using their personal information.
Sell the strangest object in the room as if your rent depends on it.
